nodes.label: USB micro ROS Transport
nodes.rationale: STM32 sensor/CAN data travels through USB CDC and the bidirectional micro-ROS Agent into raw ROS channels for collection, audit, and bridge. Collector observation does not make Agent unidirectional. Bridge allow_motor_enable=false blocks its own enable service rather than direct ROS topics, firmware arbitration, or RC. Avoid duplicate Agents on the serial device.

nodes.label: Motor Status Semantics
nodes.rationale: At the pinned reference source, status bits 0/1 denote left/right freshness, 2/3 CAN bus-off, 4 firmware enable, 5 timeout, and 6 MIT mode. Target publication rates are not measured rates. Status enable is not power/torque evidence; repeated JointState samples do not ensure fresh CAN feedback, and effort remains reported/unverified.

nodes.label: Acquisition Profile Scope
nodes.rationale: The IMU-only profile requires /imu/data and /motor_status for USB/IMU inventory; the full profile retains broader required channels plus raw motor channels. A separate narrow contract does not rescue a failed full dataset. /imu/debug cannot replace valid IMU, and --check does not verify firmware identity, physical validity, QoS, or readiness.

nodes.label: Actuator Mode Arbitration
nodes.rationale: The reference source selects velocity mode through /cmd_vel and operation-control/MIT through /cmd_mit or /cmd_torque. Do not interleave modes or stack external velocity PI over the motor velocity PI. RC can affect effective permission independently of Pi bridge settings. Collection does not change arbitration or test watchdog behavior.

nodes.label: Firmware Compatibility Uncertainty
nodes.rationale: Reference firmware commit 0d32593988cc817311d3dfdd8683df1f1b444a2c is reviewed source rather than a verified board binary. Its motor task invokes RobStride rs_ext paths on separate CAN buses, while the operator identifies Nino motors as CyberGear. README/source boot and timing differences remain uncertainty rather than proof of deployed behavior.
